image.subject: 長榮航空總經理孫嘉明
image.sourceCaption: 長榮航空總經理孫嘉明（左）頒發長榮航空馬拉松最大獎「全球不限航點經濟艙機票」給跑者。（長榮航提供）中央社記者江明晏傳真　115年10月25日

zh.title: 長榮航前9月營收創新高 油價仍為營運最大變數
zh.summary: 長榮航前9月營收創高；油價成獲利最大變數；12月德里首兩班客滿
body: 長榮航空總經理孫嘉明表示，雖然調漲票價與運價帶動營收創下新高，但高漲的航空燃油成本仍是獲利的最大變數。受地緣政治風險影響，先前國際航線航空燃油價格已達到每桶約177美元，使得航空業面臨龐大的營利壓力。
長榮航空公佈9月客運營收為新臺幣119.38億元，年增28.08%；貨運營收為61.67億元，年增42.55%；單月合併營收達207.49億元，年增32.86%，創歷年同期新高。累計今年前9個月客運營收達1213.06億元，累計合併營收達1943.8億元，均刷新歷年同期新高紀錄。
客運展望方面，隨著9月傳統北美線旺季以及年底耶誕與過年假期將至，載客需求預期再次轉強，東北亞線、歐洲線、紐澳線及兩岸航線載客率表現皆十分強勁。長榮航空規劃於12月開航印度德里航線，目前開航首兩班機位已全數客滿，主要受惠於印度往返臺灣及北美的充沛客源。
貨運方面，孫嘉明指出，受惠於人工智慧（AI）與高科技產品出貨需求旺盛，呈現全年沒有淡季的熱絡情況，帶動運價持穩續強。除了國籍航空公司供不應求外，美籍航空公司亦加開上百班次包機，長榮航空將持續爭取高附加價值貨源以提升營運表現。
此外，2026長榮航空馬拉松吸引超過2萬名海內外跑者參與。該賽事獲得國際馬拉松暨路跑總會（AIMS）國際認證，今年並獲國際媒體富比士選入全球十大特色馬拉松，賽事路線穿梭臺北市區及多個地標。

en.title: EVA Air Reports Record Nine-Month Revenue as High Fuel Prices Impact Profits
en.summary: EVA Air records high nine-month revenue; fuel prices remain key profit variable; December Delhi flights sold out
body: EVA Air General Manager Sun Chia-ming stated that while increases in passenger fares and cargo freight rates have driven overall revenues to record highs, rising jet fuel costs remain the largest variable affecting annual profitability. Due to geopolitical risks, international jet fuel prices previously reached approximately $177 per barrel, significantly impacting industry operating margins.

The airline reported September passenger revenue of NT$11.938 billion, up 28.08% year-on-year, and cargo revenue of NT$6.167 billion, up 42.55%. Consolidated revenue for September reached NT$20.749 billion, representing a 32.86% year-on-year increase and setting a record for the same month. For the first nine months, cumulative passenger revenue reached NT$121.306 billion while cumulative consolidated revenue reached NT$194.38 billion, both marking historic highs for the period.

Regarding passenger operations, travel demand is expected to strengthen further with the approaching Christmas and New Year holidays following September's traditional North American peak season. Passenger load factors across Northeast Asia, Europe, Oceania, and cross-strait routes remain strong. EVA Air plans to launch a route to Delhi, India, in December, with the first two flights already fully booked due to robust passenger volume connecting India with Taiwan and North America.

In air freight, Sun noted that strong export demand for artificial intelligence and high-tech products has eliminated the traditional off-season, keeping freight rates steady and firm. Supply remains tight among Taiwanese carriers, while U.S. airlines have added over 100 charter flights. EVA Air continues to target high-value cargo to boost operational performance.

Separately, the 2026 EVA Air Marathon attracted more than 20,000 international and domestic runners. Certified by the Association of International Marathons and Distance Races (AIMS), the event was selected by Forbes as one of the global top ten feature marathons, routing participants through landmark areas of Taipei City.

zh.title: 美國國防部與洛克希德·馬丁達成10年框架 至少採購850架F-35
zh.summary: 國防部與洛馬達成10年框架，至少850架F-35；仍需國會授權
body: 美國國防部與洛克希德·馬丁於2026年10月22日宣佈達成為期10年的框架協議，涵蓋至少850架F-35 Lightning II戰機，供美軍使用。
該協議尚非生產合同，仍需國會授權多年採購及相應撥款，雙方纔能敲定最終條款。
根據五角大樓公告，洛克希德·馬丁將自行投入至少70億美元用於支援F-35計畫。
協議範圍涵蓋第21至30批次生產，包含初始備件、10年改裝套件與維持支援，以及國際客戶訂單，總產能維持每年156架。
此前於2025年9月29日簽署的第18、19批次合同涵蓋296架，金額達243億美元；眾參兩院2027財年國防授權法案皆含多年採購條款，惟尚未成法。

en.title: Pentagon and Lockheed Martin agree 10‑year framework for at least 850 F‑35s
en.summary: Pentagon, Lockheed Martin unveil 10‑year, 850‑jet F‑35 framework pending Congress
body: The U.S. Department of Defense and Lockheed Martin announced on October 22, 2026 a ten‑year framework covering at least 850 F‑35 Lightning II fighter jets for the U.S. military.
The arrangement is not yet a production contract; it still requires congressional authorization for multiyear procurement and the associated funding before the parties can finalize terms.
Under the framework Lockheed Martin will self‑fund at least $7 billion in initiatives supporting the F‑35 program, according to the Pentagon announcement.

The company stated that the arrangement spans production Lots 21 through 30, including initial spare parts, 10 years of modification kits and sustainment, and orders from international customers, with total production remaining at 156 aircraft per year.

The previous finalized production agreement covering 296 F‑35s across Lots 18 and 19 was signed on September 29, 2025 for a combined $24.3 billion. Both the House and Senate versions of the fiscal 2027 National Defense Authorization Act include provisions for multiyear F‑35 procurement, although the legislation has yet to become law.
